answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1816 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the island. The tundra index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an hostile operator to the back of the pulse queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. That is 12 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
